name: Navalacruz (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross throughout, cantoned by four green walnut trees.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 5 January 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 21 of 2 February 1999); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a white cloth with a complete red cross, its arms one fifth of the width, cantoned by a green walnut tree in each canton.

features.role: cross throughout with arms one fifth of the width
walnut trees in the four cantons
